title: 第11章 混沌幼子第12章 巨龙列岛
lines: 意识沉沦在无光的深海。
冰冷，死寂，唯有灵魂深处永无止境的剧痛与束缚感，如同亿万根烧红的钢针，持续穿刺着他早已破碎的存在。
卡拉斯感觉自己像一块被丢弃在炼狱熔炉边缘的残铁，承受着冰与火的双重酷刑。
肋下那道被强行撕裂的伤口，每一次微弱的脉搏都带来撕裂般的灼痛，仿佛有滚烫的岩浆在皮肉下流淌。
更深处，是星尘能量残留的冰冷刺痛，如同跗骨之蛆，啃噬着骨髓。
而灵魂层面，那强行引动黑暗誓言带来的反噬，如同无形的巨磨，反复碾压着他脆弱的意志，每一次碾压都伴随着源自灵魂链接另一端传递来的、被强行束缚的狂暴挣扎意念。
那意念充满了混乱、暴戾、被侵犯的狂怒，如同无形的毒焰，灼烧着他的精神。
他想沉沦，想彻底放弃，让这无边的痛苦将自己彻底吞噬。
但每一次即将被黑暗彻底淹没时，一种更深的、源自骨髓的冰冷执念，如同深埋地底的寒铁，会猛地将他拽回痛苦的深渊。
活下去。
带它活下去。
这执念没有理由，没有希望，如同刻入灵魂的烙印，比黑暗之后的低语更根深蒂固。
它支撑着他在无边的痛苦中维持着一丝微弱得如同风中残烛的意识。
不知过了多久，也许是一瞬，也许是永恒。
一丝微弱的、带着硫磺和星尘气息的温热感，如同黑暗中的萤火，极其微弱地、断断续续地顺着那被勒紧的灵魂链接传递过来。
是暗爪。
它那被强行束缚的、狂暴的挣扎意念，似乎耗尽了力量，或者被那源自黑暗誓言的冰冷约束力暂时压制了下去。
传递过来的不再是纯粹的暴怒和混乱，而是一种深沉的、带着无尽疲惫的虚弱，以及一丝极其微弱的、如同受伤幼兽般的痛苦呜咽。
那丝微弱的热流，正是它残存的生命之火，在约束的枷锁下，如同本能般传递过来，维系着他这具残破容器最后的一线生机。
这微弱的温热，如同投入死水的石子，在卡拉斯濒临枯竭的意识中激起一丝微澜。
他艰难地、如同锈蚀的齿轮般，极其缓慢地转动了一下沉重的眼皮。
视线模糊，如同隔着一层血污凝结的毛玻璃。
塔楼底层昏暗的光线刺痛了他久居黑暗的瞳孔。
他首先看到的，是悬浮在低空中、缓缓旋转的那个东西——由他伤口喷涌的鲜血和幽暗星尘能量构成的亵渎符文。
它不再像最初那样散发着狂暴的约束之力，而是变得黯淡、稀薄了许多，如同风中摇曳的残烛。
符文的形态也有些不稳，边缘模糊，仿佛随时都会溃散。
但它的核心，那扭曲的“塔克西丝”
之名讳，依旧散发着冰冷而绝望的微光，如同一个微缩的、通往深渊的漩涡，维系着那道无形的、勒紧灵魂链接的枷锁。
符文的微光，勉强照亮了符文下方不远处的景象。
暗爪蜷缩在布满灰尘和血污的地面上。
身体覆盖着冰冷、边缘锐利、闪烁着幽暗光泽的星尘鳞片，那鳞片上布满了纵横交错的深色疤痕和凝固的蓝龙血液与裁决者的污秽。
胸膛上，那个被符文戟能量锋刃刺穿的恐怖伤口依旧狰狞，边缘覆盖着一层暗淡的、如同死灰般的暗紫色冰晶，那是裁决者残存力量的污染痕迹，阻止着伤口的完全愈合。
那对覆盖着星尘纹路的翅膀无力地收拢在身侧，翼膜上的撕裂虽然被新生组织覆盖，但依旧显得破败。
它熔金的竖瞳紧闭着，小小的头颅低垂，呼吸微弱而急促。
每一次呼吸都带着胸腔深处细微的、如同破旧风箱般的哨音。
它小小的身体随着呼吸微微颤抖，覆盖着鳞片的皮肤下，偶尔能看到一丝极其微弱的、混乱的暗紫色能量流如同垂死的电蛇般窜过——那是吞噬了裁决者灵魂本源后残留的杂质，在它体内冲突、翻腾，却被那灵魂链接上的冰冷枷锁强行压制着，无法爆发。
它很虚弱。
远比吞噬格罗兹龙晶后恢复时更加虚弱。
强行吞噬强大裁决者的灵魂和力量，以及随后被黑暗誓言的反噬强行束缚，几乎耗尽了它新生的力量。
那丝传递过来的、维系卡拉斯生机的微弱温热，仿佛就是它此刻残存的所有。
卡拉斯的目光艰难地移动，落在塔楼入口处。
裁决者那覆盖着破碎漆黑重甲的尸体，如同被丢弃的垃圾，扭曲地倒在血泊和尘埃中。
content_en:
Consciousness sinks into the lightless depths.
Cold and dead, only the never-ending pain and restraint in the depths of his soul were like billions of red-hot steel needles that continued to pierce his already broken existence.
Karas felt like a scrap of iron discarded on the edge of the infernal furnace, enduring the dual torture of ice and fire.
The forcibly torn wound under his ribs caused a tearing burning pain with every weak pulse, as if hot lava was flowing under the flesh.
Deeper, there was the cold sting of the remaining stardust energy, like tarsal maggots, gnawing at the bone marrow.
As for the soul level, the backlash caused by forcibly triggering the Dark Oath was like an invisible giant mill, repeatedly crushing his fragile will. Each crush was accompanied by a violent struggling thought that was forcibly restrained and transmitted from the other end of the soul link.
That thought was filled with chaos, violence, and violated rage, burning his spirit like an invisible poisonous flame.
He wanted to sink, to give up completely, and let this boundless pain swallow him up completely.
But every time he was about to be completely submerged by darkness, a deeper, cold obsession originating from his bone marrow, like cold iron buried deep in the ground, would violently pull him back into the abyss of pain.
Stay alive.
Keep it alive.
This obsession has no reason and no hope. It is like a brand engraved into the soul, deeper than the whisper after darkness.
It supported him in the endless pain to maintain a faint consciousness as weak as a candle in the wind.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe a moment, maybe an eternity.
A faint sense of warmth, with the smell of sulfur and stardust, was like a firefly in the dark, passing extremely weakly and intermittently along the tightened soul link.
It's Darkclaw.
Its forcibly bound and violent struggling thoughts seemed to have exhausted its power, or were temporarily suppressed by the cold binding force derived from the dark oath.
What was conveyed was no longer pure rage and chaos, but a deep, endless exhaustion of weakness, and an extremely weak whimper of pain, like a wounded cub.
That weak stream of heat was its remaining fire of life, transmitted like instinct under the shackles of restraint, maintaining the last glimmer of life in his broken vessel.
This weak warmth, like a pebble thrown into stagnant water, stirred up a slight ripple in Karas's dying consciousness.
He turned his heavy eyelids very slowly, with difficulty, like a rusty gear.
His vision was blurry, like frosted glass separated by a layer of blood.
The dim light at the bottom of the tower stung his pupils, which had been in darkness for so long.
The first thing he saw was something suspended in the low air and spinning slowly - a blasphemous rune composed of the blood spurting from his wounds and the dark stardust energy.
It no longer exudes the violent restraining power as it did at first, but has become much dimmer and thinner, like a candle swaying in the wind.
The shape of the runes is also a little unstable, the edges are blurred, and it seems that it will collapse at any time.
But at its core, the twisted "Taksis"
The name taboo still exudes a cold and desperate glimmer, like a miniature whirlpool leading to the abyss, maintaining the invisible shackles that tighten the soul connection.
The faint light of the runes barely illuminated the scene not far below the runes.
Darkpaw crouched on the dusty and bloodied ground.
The body is covered with cold, sharp-edged stardust scales that sparkle with a dark luster. The scales are covered with criss-crossing dark scars and coagulated blue dragon blood and the filth of the Judge.
On the chest, the terrifying wound pierced by the rune halberd's energy blade was still hideous, and its edges were covered with a layer of dim, ashes-like dark purple ice crystals. These were traces of contamination from the Judge's remaining power, preventing the wound from completely healing.
The pair of wings covered with stardust patterns were folded feebly at the sides. Although the tear on the wing membrane was covered with new tissue, it still looked dilapidated.
Its molten gold vertical pupils were tightly closed, its small head was drooped, and its breathing was weak and rapid.
Every breath carries a subtle whistle deep in the chest, like an old bellows.
Its small body trembled slightly with its breathing. Under the skin covered with scales, you could occasionally see an extremely weak, chaotic dark purple energy flow running through it like a dying electric snake - it was the remaining impurities after devouring the soul of the judge. It was conflicting and tumbling in its body, but was forcibly suppressed by the cold shackles on the soul link, unable to explode.
It's weak.
He was far weaker than when he recovered after swallowing the Groz Dragon Crystal.
Forcibly devouring the soul and power of the powerful Judge, and then being forcibly bound by the backlash of the Dark Oath, almost exhausted its new power.
The faint warmth that was transmitted and maintained the vitality of Karas seemed to be all that remained at this moment.
Karas' eyes moved with difficulty and landed on the entrance to the tower.
The body of the Judge, covered with broken heavy black armor, was like discarded garbage, twisted and lying in a pool of blood and dust.
